_comment: Screens the BOARD writes for itself. ONE COPY, THREE READERS.
screen-tables.ts builds BOARD_WRITTEN_NAME from this; docker-entrypoint.sh
greps the keys to decide what the image must not copy over the board's own
output; and the admin's theme checklist reads the same table IN A BROWSER -
web/config-app/vite.config.ts aliases @bbs/screens at the backend source, so
screen-tables.ts is bundled by vite and has no filesystem. That is why this
is JSON and not a text file: all three readers take it as-is, and the TS
half stays a table with no I/O, which is the property its own header claims.
A key is a JavaScript regex SOURCE, anchored whole by the reader. The shell
turns the two metacharacters into globs. The value is why the entry
qualifies, kept beside the pattern it justifies rather than in a comment
above it, so a reader in any of the three languages gets the reason.
What earns an entry: something on this board WRITES the file. Not 'the file
is stale', not 'nobody has drawn it' - a file nothing writes is an ordinary
screen that happens to be old, and marking it here would hide it from the
artists' gallery on the strength of a job that never runs.
callerslog.*: The callers log, written as callers come and go.
lastc\\.txt: The last-caller screen, rewritten at every logon.
achievetop\\.txt: The achievements leaderboard, rewritten every fifteen minutes. Its .Header and .Tailer are ART and are deliberately absent - a designer owns those.
quicknew\\.txt: QuickNew's new-files screen, regenerated by the door at every logoff. Tracked in git so a fresh board has something to show, which is how the image came to overwrite the board's own output on every deploy (2026-09-15).
bull7\\.txt: The SVT Text news headlines (page 100), rewritten every hour by WEB_NEWS_BULLETINS (services/news-bulletins.ts, NEWS_BULLETIN_SOURCES). Offered to artists in the Screen Designer as if drawn until 2026-09-28.
bull8\\.txt: The SVT Text sports headlines (page 300), rewritten every hour by the same job as bull7.
bull9\\.txt: The requests bulletin, written by the REQUESTS door whenever a caller adds or changes a request. Here by NAME because its content is the sysop's own art with no marker in it.
